timing: Exploratory fixed-context analysis designed after the published-emulator preview and fast-bridge validation, before any new GW channel integral or branching fit.

normalization.method: Independent latent-normal draws, rejection indicator for the explicit four-dimensional domain. Save full and half estimates, retain all invalid q counts. This is emulator-domain normalization MC, not detection simulation or physical support calibration.

regularizer: Normalized constant density in (m1,q,z,chi_eff) over the declared domain; joint mass area 95-3*ln(20), z length 1.9, chi_eff length 1.98. Convert to Mc with dm1/dMc, and lift using the same hidden-spin conditional as every channel. Mix after channel-domain normalization and include in both event and selection terms.

events.sources: Same fixed original-prior caches and source identity checks as validated full69 studies. Keep every event and every row; weights outside the declared target domain are zero. Average over all saved rows.

selection.early: Retain the existing explicitly conditional O1/O2 calculation; matched-filter O3 excludes cWB. Use exact released joint injection sampling_pdf, coordinate Jacobians, mixture weights, generated totals and time factors.

branching_parameter: Intrinsic channel fractions within the declared restricted domain, not all cosmic BBH mergers. Condition on catalog count and share one composition across observing runs as in the preceding conditional analysis.
prior: Dirichlet(1,1,1,1,1) on the restricted-domain intrinsic fractions, independently for each declared context/conditional/regularization/bank/policy case. No cross-context evidence comparison from omitted event constants.
independent_validation: Validate sampled event and injection weights against scalar convolution and Cartesian Jacobians, normalization by independent draw halves, and mixture posterior with a distinct numerical implementation. Do not issue a completed-inference claim before these checks.
limits: Fixed birth spin and CE efficiency; no hyperparameter inference or physical-model uncertainty marginalization.
Conditional spin laws are additional assumptions absent from the four-dimensional channel products.
Historical injection reference, hopeless screening and PE prior-excluded likelihood remain unverified.
Normalizers are finite emulator MC estimates, not known exact numbers.
Continuous flow behavior near zero spin and CE context interpretation remain diagnosed limitations.
No ESS-based deletion of rows or events; concentration diagnostics are not campaign coverage calibration.
